data.title: bn-2318t: region calculus abort step, publication slots, public substrate ledger (RFC 0026 corr. 51)

data.body: [risk:high] Suspended holders cannot discharge or transfer obligations that the substrate reports after their poll. This guard uses WorkerState::is_active, which accepts only Created and Running at worker.rs:129-133. transfer_substrate applies the same guard to the source at region.rs:1119, then rejects a suspended destination at region.rs:1120 and 1354-1362. The current A7 model treats every nonterminal, non-cancelling task as acting at crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/support/primitive_conformance_model.rs:989-995. The actual pinned journal transfers o1 after both tasks suspend at crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/pr14_impl04_obligations.rs:949-957. It later discharges obligations during cancellation before either lifecycle becomes terminal at lines 961-964. The follow-up cannot replay those accepted journals into this shared ledger without forged Resume steps or retained parallel accounting. Failure modes: valid transfers and cancellation cleanup become typed refusals, causing false nonconformance or bypassing the shared ledger. Edge cases: suspended sources, suspended receivers, cross-region handoff, and cancellation aborts from parked holders. Rollback: revert or defer only the substrate-ledger API and RFC rule while keeping explicit abort and publication slots. Monitoring: count SubstrateHolderNotLive refusals whose state is Suspended, then compare them with A7 and pinned-journal outcomes. Validation: replay the existing obligation-family golden journal through these APIs, and extend the differential model with transfer, cancel, cleanup discharge, drain, and finalize. Fix by admitting the substrate acting states, including Suspended where actual ordering requires it, or add a faithful typed cleanup transition. Preserve the separate risk:critical human approval gate.

data.reason: [risk:high] The substrate ledger rejects valid parked-holder transfers and cancellation discharges. See th-3nzexr at crates/continuum-task/src/region.rs:1398. The asupersync A7 model and pinned journal require these transitions. Fix the state gate and replay transfer plus cancellation cleanup through the shared ledger. This BLOCK does not satisfy or replace any risk:critical human approval.

data.body: Fixed in 0e285e4. One predicate, WorkerState::holds_substrate (Running or Suspended), now decides open, discharge, the transfer source and the transfer destination. open_substrate needs an Open region. discharge_substrate and transfer_substrate allow an Open or Draining region, not Finalized. Created gives SubstrateHolderNotBegun. Terminal gives SubstrateHolderNotLive. New test the_pr14_impl04_journal_shape_replays_as_a_total_teardown replays pr14_impl04_obligations.rs:949-964 as calculus steps: opens by parked holders, the o1 transfer between parked tasks in sibling regions, both discharges after cancel(r1) while both tasks are Suspended, then drain and finalize r2, r3, r1. is_total holds. The A7 transfer rule (primitive_conformance_model.rs:1441-1466) refuses only a Finalized destination region, so a Draining destination is admitted. New mutants: transfer to an unbegun or terminal destination, transfer from a terminal source, discharge after the drain cancelled the holder. The continuumd differential gains a running-only-discharge oracle mutant and pins 67 states and 362 of 1,273 admitted transitions. RFC 0026 correction 51 item 3 is rewritten to state this rule and why. just check: all pass except the lead-owned security-review-present.

[risk:high] transfer_substrate admits a no-op self-transfer and applies one holds_substrate predicate to both transfer parties (crates/continuum-task/src/region.rs:1124-1128). The cited A7 model rejects holder == current holder and requires both parties to be acting (crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/support/primitive_conformance_model.rs:1450-1455). Acting excludes acknowledged cancellation (lines 989-995 and 1081-1089), while only an aborted discharge gets the cleanup exception (lines 1430-1436). The new schedule test explicitly treats from == to as successful (crates/continuum-task/tests/region_substrate_ledger.rs:584-615), and the differential action set omits transfer entirely (crates/continuumd/tests/region_staging_differential.rs:43-63). The calculus therefore silently accepts journal sequences that A7 rejects, which can invalidate a future refinement or certificate. Failure modes: an invalid ownership event can be accepted as conforming, and a transfer can be accepted after acting authority ended. Edge cases: self-transfer, source or destination after cancellation acknowledgement, Open versus Draining before and after acknowledgement, and aborted discharge that must remain permitted. Rollback: revert the shared transfer guard and self-transfer admission while retaining the suspended open and discharge repair, or add phase-specific typed state. Monitoring: count self-transfer admissions and transfers involving cancelling holders, then compare them with A7 Fault::ObligationPhase refusals. Validation: add TransferSub to the differential with two workers and regions, a same-holder mutant, requested and acknowledged cancellation phases, and the pinned journal replay. Preserve the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

[risk:high] The parked-holder cleanup case is now admitted at crates/continuum-task/src/region/worker.rs:153-166 and region.rs:1091-1128. The pinned journal shape is covered. Re-review remains blocked by th-2lt2pp: the shared predicate over-admits transfer relative to A7, including a same-holder transfer and post-acknowledgement parties.

data.reason: risk:high th-2lt2pp: transfer_substrate over-admits self-transfer and cancellation-phase parties relative to the cited A7 model; the differential omits transfer.

data.body: Fixed in 06cbbea. transfer_substrate now refuses from == to with the new SubstrateSelfTransfer. Both parties must hold substrate (Running or Suspended) and must not be in a Draining(Cancelled) region, else SubstrateRegionNotOpen. A normally closed region is not cancelling, because A7's acting does not depend on a close. Only discharge keeps the cleanup exception, and open is unchanged. The draining-transfer test is now a refusal mutant at both ends. The schedule test expects SubstrateSelfTransfer. The continuumd differential gains worker B, the region cancel, and TransferAB, TransferBA and TransferAA: 668 states and 4,968 of 18,704 transitions admitted, both pinned. Five oracle mutants are detected, including a self-transfer and a transfer that ignores cancellation. RFC 0026 corr. 51 item 3 is updated. Self-audit against A7 (open 1405-1424, discharge 1426-1437, transfer 1441-1466, acting 990, may_clean_up 1093, generator 2160-2210). The remaining divergences: (1) A7 acting includes Created, so A7 admits an open, transfer to, or transfer from a Created task. The calculus refuses (SubstrateHolderNotBegun), which is stricter, per the lead ruling. (2) Cancelling: A7 uses the task's cancel phase (Acknowledged or Done). The calculus has no acknowledge step, so it uses the region state Draining(Cancelled). Between cancel-request and acknowledge, A7 still admits a transfer and a committed discharge, and the calculus refuses the transfer. That is stricter; a real journal that transfers in that window would lift as a violation. (3) Discharge has no committed/aborted distinction in the calculus. After acknowledge, A7 admits only an aborted discharge, and the calculus admits any discharge by a Running or Suspended holder, which is more permissive. A fix needs a discharge-outcome parameter and an acknowledge notion (lift follow-up or bn-36wy3). (4) A per-task cancel without a region cancel (a deadline) makes an A7 task non-acting in an Open region. The calculus cannot represent it until bn-36wy3 lands. (5) Ids: A7 needs dense sequential ids, and the calculus accepts any fresh id, which is harmless. (6) A7 has an explicit Leaked step. The calculus reports a leak as an outstanding obligation at finalize. just check: all pass except the lead-owned security-review-present.

[risk:high] Verified at 06cbbea: transfer_substrate now refuses self-transfer at crates/continuum-task/src/region.rs:1143-1149 and rejects either party in Draining(Cancelled) at lines 1150-1151 and 1397-1408. The differential now covers both rules at crates/continuumd/tests/region_staging_differential.rs:357-380 and 641-648. This finding is fixed.

[risk:high] Verified at 06cbbea: WorkerState::holds_substrate admits Running and Suspended at crates/continuum-task/src/region/worker.rs:153-168. Open, discharge, and transfer use that predicate through crates/continuum-task/src/region.rs:1373-1448. The pinned journal replay covers parked holders at crates/continuum-task/tests/region_substrate_ledger.rs:336-390. This finding is fixed.

[risk:high] `discharge_substrate` erases the discharge outcome and therefore admits a committed discharge after cancellation. The public method takes only holder and obligation, while `check_holder` accepts Running or Suspended holders in `Draining(Cancelled)` at crates/continuum-task/src/region.rs:1425-1448. A7 instead admits a discharge after cancellation acknowledgement only when it is aborted: crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/support/primitive_conformance_model.rs:1424-1436 checks `acting || (!committed && may_clean_up)`. The production binding preserves this distinction as `Discharge::Committed` and `Discharge::Aborted` at crates/continuum-asupersync/src/binding.rs:2918-2937 and 2948-2997. Thus open, cancel, committed discharge, drain, finalize becomes total here although A7 rejects it. The differential repeats the omission at crates/continuumd/tests/region_staging_differential.rs:329-355, so its agreement cannot detect this case. Failure modes: a post-cancellation commit can be accepted as valid cleanup, and the ledger can report false totality for a journal that fails A7. Edge cases: committed versus aborted discharge before and after acknowledgement, Running versus Suspended holders, and normally closed versus cancelling regions. Rollback: revert the adapter-ledger entry point and its RFC claim, or add a typed discharge outcome plus the cancellation phase needed to apply the A7 guard. Monitoring: count committed discharges from cancelling holders and compare them with A7 `Fault::TaskPhase` refusals. Validation: add committed and aborted discharge actions to the differential, model request and acknowledgement separately, replay the pinned aborted journal, and add a committed-after-ack mutant that must be refused. Preserve the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

data.reason: risk:high th-25yjwp: discharge_substrate lacks a committed-versus-aborted outcome, so cancellation cleanup can accept a committed discharge that A7 rejects and report false totality. Preserve the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

data.body: Fixed in d880dd9. discharge_substrate(holder, obligation, outcome) takes SubstrateOutcome::{Committed, Aborted}. An Open or Draining(Closed) region admits both. A Draining(Cancelled) region admits only Aborted. Committed there is refused as SubstrateCommitDuringCancellation and the ledger is unchanged. Step::DischargeSubstrate carries the outcome. The pr14_impl04 journal replay now discharges as Aborted and still tears down totally. New mutant: a commit during cancellation is refused and changes nothing, the abort is admitted, and a commit in a closed region is admitted. The continuumd differential splits each holder's discharge into commit and abort, and adds a sixth mutant (commit during cancellation), which is detected. It pins 668 states and 5,084 of 20,040 transitions admitted. RFC 0026 corr. 51 item 3 states the outcome rule and a known strictness paragraph owned by bn-36wy3. Self-audit again against A7 (open 1405-1424, discharge 1426-1437, transfer 1441-1466, acting 990, may_clean_up 1093, generator 2160-2210): Open, the calculus and A7 agree except for Created (lead ruling, calculus stricter). Discharge: they agree on commit and abort outside cancellation, on abort during cancellation, and on refusal after terminal. The only difference is a commit between cancel request and acknowledgement (A7 admits, calculus refuses; bn-36wy3). Transfer: they agree on self-transfer, acting parties and holder mismatch, except Created (lead ruling) and the request-to-acknowledge window (bn-36wy3). Single-task cancel is not representable until bn-36wy3. Non-rule differences only: dense ids in A7 (harmless) and the Leaked event, which the calculus reports as an obligation still owed at finalize. just check: all pass except the lead-owned security-review-present.

[risk:high] Verified at d880dd9. SubstrateOutcome preserves committed versus aborted at crates/continuum-task/src/region/obligation.rs:194-223. discharge_substrate refuses a committed outcome in Draining(Cancelled) before changing the record or ledger at crates/continuum-task/src/region.rs:1128-1147. The schedule carries the outcome at crates/continuum-task/src/region/schedule.rs:95-103 and 279-285. The refusal and unchanged-ledger case is pinned at crates/continuum-task/tests/region_substrate_ledger.rs:483-512. The differential checks both outcomes and detects a permissive mutant at crates/continuumd/tests/region_staging_differential.rs:269-285, 352-358, and 699-705. Failure modes: the repaired path cannot accept a post-cancellation commit as cleanup or use it to report false totality. Edge cases: commit and abort in open, normally closed, and cancelling regions; running and suspended holders; wrong holder; terminal holder. Rollback: revert the adapter-ledger claim if the typed outcome or guard is removed. Monitoring: compare committed discharges in cancelling holders with SubstrateCommitDuringCancellation refusals. Validation: retain the direct mutant, the independent 668-state and 20,040-transition differential, and the pinned aborted journal replay. This finding is fixed. The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains required.

data.reason: Verified fixed at d880dd9: typed discharge outcome and fail-closed cancellation guard are covered by direct and differential evidence.

LGTM for the full persisted range fa2cdf9..d880dd9. Reviewed all nine changed files and the supporting A7 and binding paths. All three risk:high findings are fixed. No open security findings remain. This static vote does not satisfy the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.
